We are seeking an experienced & skilled Senior Schedule Leader to support a pioneering international industrial megaproject in Sweden

Role Overview
You will lead and coordinate all planning and scheduling activities within a large-scale EPC/EPCM environment, ensuring the integrity of integrated project schedules and alignment with project milestones, contractual commitments, and client expectations.

Develop and maintain the Scheduling Management Plan, standards, and procedures.
Lead the preparation and control of integrated master schedules (engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning).

Implement and enhance control methodologies such as Earned Value Management (EVM) and KPI tracking.
Lead schedule review workshops with project teams, contractors, and the Client PMO.
Provide clear, solution-oriented reporting to support senior management decision-making.
Support claims management and ensure compliance with international standards and contractual frameworks.
Mentor and guide planners, fostering a high-performance planning culture.

Profile
10+ years of experience in project planning within large EPC/EPCM projects (mining, energy, oil & gas, infrastructure, etc.).
Experience in megaprojects (>USD 500M) with full responsibility for integrated schedules.
Expert in Primavera P6; strong knowledge of MS Project and reporting tools (Power BI).
Strong expertise in CPM, EVM, risk-adjusted planning, and forensic schedule analysis.
Knowledge of PMI, AACEI, ISO 21500, FIDIC, NEC, and EPC contractual models.
Proven leadership, decision-making ability under pressure, and experience in multicultural environments.
Willingness to travel or relocate as required.
Advanced English.

jobs.occupation: Part-Time Café & Restaurant Assistant Moms Kitchen
jobs.description:
Part-Time Café & Restaurant Assistant – Mom’s Kitchen
Mom’s Kitchen is looking for a reliable, motivated, and customer-oriented part-time team member to join our friendly café and restaurant team in Östermalm, Stockholm.
We are looking for someone who enjoys working with people, takes pride in their work, and understands the importance of excellent customer service.
Your responsibilities will include:
Welcoming customers and providing friendly, professional service.
Preparing and serving food and beverages.
Handling payments and operating the cash register.
Processing online takeaway and delivery orders.
Maintaining cleanliness, hygiene, and organisation throughout the restaurant.
Assisting with food preparation and daily restaurant operations.
Working closely with colleagues to ensure smooth and efficient service.

What we are looking for:
A positive, friendly, and professional attitude.
Strong customer service and communication skills.
Reliability, punctuality, and a strong work ethic.
The ability to work independently and take initiative.
Good organisational skills and attention to detail.
The ability to remain calm and efficient during busy periods.
A willingness to learn and contribute to the team.

Language Requirements:
Good communication skills in English are required. Swedish is an advantage but not essential.
Previous Experience:
Previous café or restaurant experience is beneficial but not required. We value motivation, responsibility, and a willingness to learn.
About Mom’s Kitchen:
At Mom’s Kitchen, we believe that great food, genuine hospitality, and excellent customer service go hand in hand.
We are looking for someone who shares our values and wants to contribute to a welcoming, organised, and professional working environment.
Employment Type: Part-time
Location: Östermalm, Stockholm
